P1: 7号道路 is a short path that links 金黄市 to the east and 玉虹市 to the west. The western end of the second Underground Path emerges here, but authorities have closed the tunnel indefinitely because of rowdy Trainers battling inside.
P2: 玉虹市 is located between 7号道路 to the east and 16号道路 to the west. The Celadon Department Store in the northwest offers all kinds of items for sale, and the Celadon Condominiums acts as a hotel. Visitors can try their luck at the Game Corner in the heart of the city and redeem their winnings at the Prize Corner next door. The Celadon Gym stands on a hill in the southwest part of town.
D2: North side of the city, at the west end of the tree-lined path
D3: Celadon Condominiums; from the man on the roof, after listening to his storyNight
D4: Dead-end path in the south-southeast part of the city (hidden)
D5: Celadon Department Store (2F); from Crasher Wake
D6: Celadon Department Store (2F); from Crasher Wake
D7: Celadon Department Store (2F); from Crasher Wake
D8: Celadon Gym; from Gym Leader Erika, after defeating her
D10: Celadon Condominiums (3F); from the Sound Designer, after obtaining all 16 Badges
P3: Enter the Celadon Condominiums building and enter the elevator on 1F. Climb to 3F to visit the Game Freak Development Room. When you step out of the elevator, 琴音/响 and Marill rush over to greet you. She/He excitedly tells you that the Sound Designer just showed her/him a cool device, a high-tech machine that plays retro music originally from the Game Boy. The designer is apparently hoping to give the device to someone who has won all of the Kanto Badges. Lyra/Ethan suggests that you go for it, then hurries off. The Sound Designer can be found standing near the large globe in the corner. Speak to him after obtaining all 16 Badges, and he rewards you with the ＧＢ播放器.
P4: After the sun sets, enter the Celadon Condominiums building and climb the stairs to 2F. There are two elevators here. The left-hand elevator is inaccessible from here, and leads between 1F, 3F, and the roof. Take the right-hand elevator instead to reach the rooftop's inner area. Speak to the man in the exterior room to hear a scary story, and receive a 诅咒之符 for listening to the entire thing.
P5: The restaurant on the south side of town is currently hosting an eat-a-thon. It seems as though Maylene is no pushover!
P6: The prizes offered next door are expensive, so it will require a large number of coins to receive all of them. Like the one in 满金市, the Celadon Game Corner features only the Voltorb Flip card game.
P7: Like the Goldenrod Game Corner, this one also offers rare Pokémon and items as prizes.
P8: Speak to the Guitarist standing next to the counter, and he mentions how his secret skill allows him to identify a Pokémon's hidden power. The move 觉醒力量 changes its type based on an individual Pokémon's attributes, which can give the user a valuable way to cover its weaknesses. Show the man a Pokémon, and he reveals the type that 觉醒力量 would take if used by the Pokémon.
P9: The Celadon Department Store is the largest shop in Kanto. Nearly any item a Trainer could want can be found here.
P10: The Trainer's Market is found on the second floor. Everyday items like 超级球s and 好伤药s are offered here.
P11: A masked man can be seen standing near the counter on 2F. Speak to him, and he assumes that you want his Crasher Wake mask, and adamantly refuses to ever let it go. He then realizes that you were more interested in the other mask that he was examining, and gives you the Turtwig Mask Accessory instead. The man eventually gives you a Chimchar Mask and Piplup Mask, as well. He has already paid for them, and gives them as a gift from "the one who wears masks the best".
P12: The third floor holds the TM Shop. Technical Machines for several rare moves can be purchased here.
P13: Wiseman Gifts is located on the fourth floor. The shop offers a few souvenir items for sale.
P14: The Battle Collection can be found on the fifth floor. Battle items and vitamins are offered here.
P15: The Rooftop Atrium houses a picnic area and several vending machines.
C1:
Celadon City Pokémon Gym
Leader: Erika
The Nature-Loving Princess
P16: The Celadon Gym specializes in 草 Pokémon. Grass-type moves are super effective against 地面-, 岩石-, and 水 Pokémon, while Grass-type Pokémon are weak to 虫-, 火-, 飞行-, 冰-, and 毒 moves.
P17: The Gym is designed as a greenhouse, with many flower arrangements on display. Use 居合斩 to clear a path and pass under the first archway. Turn left, pass by Twins Jo & Zoe, then move in a clockwise "C" direction. Loop around the flowerbed in the middle of the Gym to pass under the archway in the southeast corner, then go north. Continue on past Picnicker Tanya, then turn west. Pass by Beauty Julia and walk under the middle and western archways. Use Cut a second and third time to remove two more small trees to reach the Gym Leader.
P18: Erika leads with her 毽子棉. Both 寄生种子 and 终极吸取 steal the target's HP, and 大晴天 triggers its Chlorophyll Ability to boost its already-high 速度. As a Flying Pokémon, it takes massive damage from 冰 attacks. Her 蔓藤怪 can further harass its target with 催眠粉, and 原始之力 lets it fight back against the 草 type's common counters: 火, Ice, 虫, and 飞行 Pokémon. 大食花's 飞叶风暴 is powerful, but cuts its 特攻 with every use. As plants rely on the sun for nutrients, Erika's remaining two Pokémon rely on 大晴天 to prepare their combination moves. 大食花 regains more HP than normal under harsh sunlight with 光合作用, and 美丽花 does the same. Under these conditions, Bellossom can launch its strongest move, 日光束, without first taking a turn to charge it.
P19: After the battle, Erika awards you the 彩虹徽章. She also hands out 招式学习器19（终极吸取） as a prize.
